FeatureCollect: Send one link and let many people fill the form out — every submission is saved as its own copy.
FeatureExport: Results can pile up into a spreadsheet automatically, or flow straight into your own database.
FeatureForms: Turn a PDF into an interactive form with fields people fill out right in the browser.
FeatureGallery: Start from a ready-made form in the gallery instead of building one from scratch.
FormsColumns: Click the gear to choose the columns you care about — tags, owner, or the date of the last activity.
FormsCreate: Two ways to start collecting, depending on whether this is a new form or a routine you repeat.
FormsCreateSpace: Form space — a fresh space for a form you are about to collect.
FormsCreateTemplate: Space template — reuse a setup you have already configured.
FormsFilter: Filters narrow the list down when the name alone is not enough.
FormsFilterTags: Tag your spaces by department or campaign, then filter by a tag — or by owner and member.
FormsInfoPanel: The info panel is where you run a form space: who is in it and what they can see.
FormsInfoPanelFillers: Give people the Form filler role — they can fill out forms, nothing more.
FormsInfoPanelHistory: The history shows who submitted a form, and when.
FormsInfoPanelPrivacy: A filler sees only their own submissions, so respondents never see each other's answers.
FormsIntro: This section lists form spaces, not single files.
FormsIntroPersonal: A PDF form you just want to fill out yourself belongs in your personal files.
FormsIntroSpaces: One space per form you collect — it holds the form, the people, and every submission.
FormsItem: Every row is a form space you can act on without opening it.
FormsItemContextMenu: The three dots open all actions: invite people, copy the shared link, edit the space, save it as a template.
FormsItemOpen: Click the name to go inside, where the blank form and the submissions live.
FormsItemPin: Pin the collections you are actively running and they stay at the top.
FormsQuickAccess: Recent keeps the spaces you opened lately at the top, so you don't scroll for them.
FormsQuickAccessFavorites: Star a space and it stays in Favorites, right above.
FormsSearch: Find a form space by name — results update as you type.
FormsSearchScope: Search looks through space names, not the answers inside the submissions.
FormsSpace: A form space is the whole collection process in one place: upload the blank PDF form, then share it.
FormsSpaceComplete: Each person's submission is saved as a separate copy in the Complete folder.
FormsSpaceLink: Share a fill-out link that works even for people without an account.
FormsSpaceXlsx: Turn on XLSX collection and every submission becomes a row in a spreadsheet — one column per field.
FormsTemplates: Collecting the same form every quarter? Save the space as a template.
FormsTemplatesKeeps: A template keeps the blank form, the roles, the tags, and the result settings.
FormsTrash: Deleted form spaces land in Trash, so a wrong click is not the end. Restore one from there, or empty Trash to free up space.
